conclusions: Operational/protocol failures were separated from physical failures.
Host-framework stability and mobile-ion transport semantics are separated.
Gamma-LiAlO2 required more evidence before a transport-regime claim and became NONDIFFUSIVE only after the authorized one-shot full extension.
Legacy B6-B8 remain deferred under the Rhombus 2.0 roadmap.
limitations: Current held-out material evidence is diagnostic/reference only, not strong blind qualification.
Phase 0 does not establish conductivity, self-diffusion, tracer diffusion, synthesis success, or application fitness.
External sealed qualification remains future work.
